title: Ukraine: Kyiv residents endure 'worst night of the year' over the weekend
summary: Rescue teams are still working to stabilise buildings in Kyiv after massive Russian strikes over the weekend. Residents described it as the worst night of the year so far, with a high number of casualties. According to our correspondent Gulliver Cragg, the attacks appeared to target the city centre but were largely repelled thanks to air defence systems.
